description: a unit cylinder (radius 1, z -1..1) fused with a plate, z -1.25..-0.25, whose outline is the rectangle [-0.5, 0.5] x [0, 0.5] under a half disc of radius 0.5 about (0, 0.5): the arc is tangent inside the cylinder's wall along x = 0, y = 1. The plate is inside the cylinder for z in -1..-0.25 and stands 0.25 out below it, so V = 2 pi + (1/2 + pi / 8) / 4 and A = 6 pi + 1/2 + pi / 8 (the cylinder's 4 pi side, its top, and its bottom whole as the plate covers the rest of it from below, plus the plate's rim 2 + pi / 2 over 0.25). Arris faults with a section edge ending at a node nothing else reaches, the arc's touching ruling meeting the cylinder's wall from inside (SplitFault::Dangling). The desired result is Full-green (plans/tangency-faults step 4)

analytic.occt_odd_euler: Open CASCADE carries the touching ruling as an edge of four faces, so its shape has an odd Euler characteristic
